claims.claim_text_normalized: FCOS is an anchor-free and proposal-free one-stage object detector.
claims.evidence_quote_short: our proposed detector FCOS is anchor box free, as well as proposal free.

claims.claim_text_normalized: FCOS with ResNeXt-64x4d-101 achieves 44.7% in AP with single-model and single-scale testing.
claims.evidence_quote_short: FCOS with ResNeXt-64x4d-101 achieves 44.7% in AP with single-model and single-scale testing

claims.claim_text_normalized: FCOS outperforms the anchor-based counterpart RetinaNet by 2.4% in AP with the same backbone.
claims.evidence_quote_short: FCOS outperforms the RetinaNet with the same backbone ResNet-101-FPN by 2.4% in AP

claims.claim_text_normalized: The center-ness branch improves the detection performance under all metrics.
claims.evidence_quote_short: The center-ness branch can boost AP from 33.5% to 37.1%

claims.claim_text_normalized: Detection performance of anchor-based detectors is sensitive to the sizes, aspect ratios and number of anchor boxes.
claims.evidence_quote_short: detection performance is sensitive to the sizes, aspect ratios and number of anchor boxes.

claims.claim_text_normalized: FCOS completely avoids the complicated computation related to anchor boxes such as calculating overlapping during training.
claims.evidence_quote_short: FCOS completely avoids the complicated computation related to anchor boxes such as calculating overlapping during training.

claims.claim_text_normalized: FCOS can be used as Region Proposal Networks in two-stage detectors and achieve significantly better performance than anchor-based RPN counterparts.
claims.evidence_quote_short: FCOS can be used as a Region Proposal Networks (RPNs) in two-stage detectors and can achieve significantly better performance than its anchor-based RPN counterparts.

claims.claim_text_normalized: Multi-level prediction with FPN can largely eliminate the ambiguity from overlapping bounding boxes.
claims.evidence_quote_short: with multi-level prediction, the ambiguity can be greatly resolved
